records.translation: Dear colleagues at Softstar Entertainment, thank you so much for taking the time to try out <Doraemon Monopoly>. Please provide your feedback!
As this is only an alpha version, some features are not yet available. We apologize for the inconvenience!
The game's execution speed has not been optimized; the official version will be faster.

From Volume 2

N-S Crest

After use, encountering someone with the same pole crest makes you immediately turn around and leave.

From Volume 2

Reverse Pen

After use, the Dorayaki punishment and reward are swapped between the two people.

From Volume 4

Dividing Blade

After use, you can have two versions of yourself! 

From Volume 42

Take-copter

The copter allows you to fly over all traps, but prevents you from buying land or upgrading.
